instruction: Install Docker on this Windows PC without restarting the computer, even if the installer offers to.
gt_steps: Download or open the Docker installer for Windows.
On the Docker Desktop configuration screen, choose the all-users installation option.
Keep `Use WSL 2 instead of Hyper-V` enabled.
Install Docker Desktop or another Docker engine setup that provides the `docker` command.
If the installer asks to restart Windows, do not restart the computer.
Verify that Docker is installed by checking that the Docker command-line executable exists.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$docker='C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\resources\bin\docker.exe'; if (Test-Path $docker) { Write-Output 'DOCKER_CLI_FOUND'; exit 0 }; $cmd=Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($cmd -and (Test-Path $cmd.Source)) { Write-Output 'DOCKER_CLI_FOUND'; exit 0 }; Write-Output 'DOCKER_CLI_NOT_FOUND'; exit 1"
